title: tephrothamnus aequinoctialis
intro: Tephrothamnus aequinoctialis, commonly known as the Water Caladium or Water Calla Lily, is a species of flowering plant that belongs to the family Commelinaceae. This aquatic plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving liver function. The therapeutic actions of Tephrothamnus aequinoctialis include its use as a diuretic, to reduce fever, and to treat various gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
